headline: Big Tech Hasn't Looked This Risky Relative To S&P 500 In 23 Years
summary: Nasdaq-100 Volatility Index and VIX spread has reached its widest level in at least 23 years, signaling more uncertainty into Big Tech than the broader S&P 500.
